messages.faqDescription: Answers about character variations, directional sprites, animation frames, exports, credits, and usage rights.

faq.question: What can this AI Sprite Generator create?
faq.answer: SpritePixel can create original 2D characters, outfit variations, directional character views, animation frames, export-ready sprite sheets, and matching game icon sets. The available controls depend on the asset workflow you choose.

faq.question: Can I create outfit variations of the same character?
faq.answer: Yes. Start from the same base character or reference and create costume variations for skins, classes, or NPC versions while preserving the character's core identity as closely as the generation allows.

faq.question: Can I generate multi-direction sprites?
faq.answer: Yes. You can create consistent directional views of a character for RPG and top-down workflows, including front, side, and back-facing outputs according to the selected direction settings.

faq.question: Can I generate animated sprite frames?
faq.answer: Yes. The AI Sprite Generator can create movement or action-based frame sequences from a character. You can preview the result and continue to the animation editor before downloading.

faq.question: Can I export sprite sheets?
faq.answer: Yes. Generated frames can be organized and downloaded as sprite sheets or frame sequences for use in your development workflow. Downloads and exports do not consume generation credits.

faq.question: Are Sprite Sheet Maker and Sprite Sheet Cutter free?
faq.answer: Yes. Both tools run in the browser and can be used without generation credits. The AI Game Icon Generator is an AI-powered generation feature and uses credits.

faq.question: Who is SpritePixel for?
faq.answer: SpritePixel is designed for indie developers, 2D game creators, RPG and top-down projects, prototype teams, and game jam creators who need usable assets without a large art pipeline.

faq.question: Can I use the generated sprites in my game project?
faq.answer: Yes, subject to the SpritePixel Terms and the rights of any reference material you upload. You are responsible for ensuring that your prompts and uploaded assets do not infringe third-party rights.
